assessment: DDX39B is a helicase with known functions in mRNA splicing and nuclear export. This important study provides convincing evidence that DDBX39B regulates Foxp3, a lineage marker for T-regulatory cells in the immune system. The work provides a detailed analysis of the post-transcriptional regulation of Foxp3, and also positions DDX39B more broadly, as an important player in the regulation of autoimmune responses. The work will be of interest to RNA biologists, immunologists, and those studying autoimmune disorders.
